scripts.dev: concurrently --names "client,server" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently --names "client,server" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:https --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.dev:http: concurrently --names "client,server" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:http --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
